_meta.description: Post-split baseline: measured from the four separate entry points, for tracking future regressions from this point forward. NOT the pre-split measurement — see HISTORICAL_PRE_SPLIT_AGGREGATE in this script and AUDIT_REMEDIATION_AND_RELEASE_PLAN.md 5.1. Re-measured again for spec 1.4.0 on the same grounds: quotes.elisionClitics adds two short lists to eight locale files, and the citations backing them add prose to those files' `sources`, which is part of the public LocaleData type and therefore embedded. Growth is ~22 KB raw / ~5 KB gzip per entry, visible as +7% on `text` and `yaml` because those entries are almost nothing but data. No code path was added to any entry; scripts/check-entry-reach.mjs still proves the module graph independently. Worth a separate look some day: `sources` is citation prose no runtime reads, and it ships to every browser.
